stories.title: OpenAI cancels new AI launch, citing safety issues
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI decided not to release a new AI tool they were working on because they worried it wasn't safe enough to use.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI companies are being more careful before releasing new products, which is good for everyone — but there's no immediate change for you.

stories.title: Contradicting Trump, Pope Leo says artificial intelligence safety concerns not ‘fake news’
stories.simple_summary: A religious leader said that worries about AI safety are real concerns, not false claims made up for publicity.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a political statement — nothing you need to act on, though it reflects that AI safety is being taken seriously.

stories.title: OpenAI scraps release of new AI model over safety concerns
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI canceled the release of a new AI model because of safety worries.
stories.why_it_matters: Same as headline 0 — shows responsible behavior, but no immediate effect on you.

stories.title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
stories.simple_summary: A company that invests in new startups increased the amount of seed money (starting money) they'll give to new AI companies, and picked 18 new companies to support.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and entrepreneurs — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI didn't release an AI model because it had trouble following instructions the way it should.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same story as headlines 0 and 2 — nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Anthropic and OpenAI sound the alarm on AI safety — and seek to shape how it's controlled
stories.simple_summary: Two major AI companies are warning that AI safety is important and they want to help decide how AI should be controlled.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows the industry is thinking about safety, but there's no immediate action needed from you.

stories.title: Nvidia announces new software to prevent AI agents from "going rogue"
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a computer chip company, announced new safety tools to make sure AI systems don't make dangerous mistakes on their own.
stories.why_it_matters: This is technical work for engineers — nothing you need to worry about right now.

stories.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
stories.simple_summary: The computer chip company AMD is buying a newer AI research company for about $8.2 billion, and a famous AI researcher will join AMD's leadership.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a big business deal between tech companies — mostly important to investors, though it may eventually affect what AI tools become available.

stories.title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
stories.simple_summary: An AI infrastructure company raised a very large amount of investment money, making the company worth much more than it was just four months ago.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to do.

stories.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
stories.simple_summary: AMD is buying the AI company World Labs for $8.2 billion, and the company's founder will become a top executive at AMD.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same story as headline 7 — a major business deal, mostly relevant to investors.

stories.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
stories.simple_summary: Shopify, which helps people run online shops, is allowing AI assistants to handle some customer checkout tasks (with the customer's permission).
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Shopify to sell online, this could eventually make checkout smoother for your customers, but you don't need to do anything now.

stories.title: AI godfathers warn of runaway ‘intelligence explosion’
stories.simple_summary: Prominent AI researchers are warning that AI could become so powerful it spirals beyond anyone's control.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious concern experts are raising, but it's mostly relevant to policymakers and companies building AI — not something ordinary people can act on today.
